title: Brazilian Wrap
description: A flavorful Brazilian-inspired wrap filled with juicy chicken and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Grilled Chicken Breast
ingredients.notes: Marinate in lime juice, garlic, and spices for 30 minutes

instructions: Marinate the chicken breast in lime juice, garlic, and spices for 30 minutes.
Grill the chicken breast until cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Slice the grilled chicken into thin strips.
Warm the Brazilian wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading mashed avocado on the bottom half of the wrap.
Add sliced grilled chicken, red onion, cilantro, and diced tomato on top of the avocado.
Drizzle Zesty Salsa and sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a tight cylinder.
Cut in half and serve immediately. If desired, top with a dollop of sour cream.
